faqPage.title: BulkSkart FAQ: How the B2B Wholesale Marketplace Works
faqPage.description: Answers about BulkSkart: what it is, whether it is free for buyers, how to post an RFQ, how suppliers are verified, how it differs from IndiaMART, and more.

brandFaq.a: BulkSkart (bulkskart.com) is a B2B wholesale marketplace. Buyers find manufacturers and wholesale suppliers, compare quotations and post buying requirements (RFQs); manufacturers list their products and reply to buyers. BulkSkart is run by Tech Pod AI Database Private Limited, an Indian company.
Yes. Signing up as a buyer, browsing products and suppliers, and posting a buying requirement (RFQ) on BulkSkart are free.

brandFaq.q: How do I post a buying requirement (RFQ) on BulkSkart?
brandFaq.a: Open Post Requirement, describe the product, the quantity, your budget and the delivery location, and submit it. Suppliers who deal in that product can send you quotations, and you compare them in your BulkSkart dashboard.

brandFaq.q: How do manufacturers and suppliers sell on BulkSkart?
brandFaq.a: Register as a manufacturer, set up your business profile and list your products. Replying to buyers' requirements and seeing buyer contact details need a paid supplier plan; the Pricing page shows the current plans.

Suppliers can complete verification on BulkSkart, where their business details such as their GST registration are checked, and verified suppliers carry a verified mark. The BulkSkart supplier directory lists only manufacturers whose GST registration was found active. For a large order, still ask for samples and documents, or book a factory visit.

No. Most manufacturers on BulkSkart are in India, and buyers anywhere in the world can post requirements and reach Indian manufacturers and exporters. Businesses outside India can also list themselves on the BulkSkart supplier map.

brandFaq.q: What products can I buy on BulkSkart?
brandFaq.a: BulkSkart has {categoryCount} categories and {subcategoryCount} subcategories, including electronics and home appliances, industrial and engineering supplies, construction material, apparel and garments, FMCG and groceries, hospital and medical supplies, packaging, chemicals, mechanical parts, agriculture and automobile parts.

brandFaq.q: How is BulkSkart different from IndiaMART?
brandFaq.a: Both are B2B marketplaces. On BulkSkart a buyer posts one requirement and compares the quotations in one dashboard, phone numbers and e-mail addresses are not shown publicly, and suppliers can be checked against their GST registration. BulkSkart is not affiliated with IndiaMART.

brandFaq.q: Can I see a supplier's phone number on BulkSkart?
brandFaq.a: Phone numbers and e-mail addresses are not shown publicly on BulkSkart, to protect members from spam calls. You reach suppliers through BulkSkart: send an enquiry from a product or post a requirement.

BulkSkart is not a lender. Buyers and manufacturers can request a business loan on BulkSkart; BulkSkart collects the KYC documents and shares the application with a lending partner (a bank or NBFC), which decides on the loan, its amount and its terms.

Yes. BulkSkart's AI assistant helps buyers describe what they need and matches requirements with suppliers in BulkSkart's own catalogue, and manufacturers on the higher plans can draft quotations with AI.
BulkSkart is a product of Tech Pod AI Database Private Limited, India.
Use the Contact page on bulkskart.com for support, partnerships and trade enquiries.

Yes. Signing up as a buyer, browsing and posting a buying requirement (RFQ) on BulkSkart are free.

faq.q: Can a manufacturer list on BulkSkart and IndiaMART at the same time?
